results.name: Everybody Hates Chris
results.overview: Chris is a teenager growing up as the eldest of three children in Brooklyn, New York during the early 1980s. Uprooted to a new neighborhood and bused to a predominantly white middle school two-hours away by his strict, hard-working parents, Chris struggles to find his place while keeping his siblings in line at home and surmounting the challenges of junior high.

results.name: Everybody Still Hates Chris
results.overview: A re-imagined animated version of Chris Rock's beloved autobiographical family comedy Everybody Hates Chris.

results.title: Everybody Hates Christmas
results.overview: A community of people have lost faith in Christmas, and everything that comes with it, until an angel comes along and reminds them all that the spirit of Christmas is more than just giving and receiving presents.
